record.rationale: React DOM replaces the native VCL window presenter;no native implementation file is falsely claimed as the owner of browser code. Source composition is referenced in the capability evidence.
responsibilities: TaskSGE6BG implements controlled React/Tailwind Calc presenters for native grid,input-window and sheet-tab responsibilities. They consume actual ScViewData/ScMarkData and controller display/input projections,never a second cell,selection or draft model. The grid paints a bounded viewport on a full-domain scroll canvas,with logical ARIA coordinates,source active/marked cell state,headers,inline edit focus and unchanged keyboard/pointer/IME intents. Input-window function/sum/equals and OK/cancel composition follows native mode switching. Tabs read actual sheet names and selected/active identities. Native commands,formatting,draft state and navigation stay with their controllers. Exact Writer toolbar-button styles are extracted into framework/browser/presentation/office-control-styles.ts and shared by Writer/Calc; global fonts,slate/indigo palette,Tailwind,rounded states and Lucide icons are reused. This task implements presentation contracts,not a registered production Calc module or complete editable workbench.

TaskYDAWMM repairs actual browser accessibility defects exposed by task10 axe acceptance. Shared top-level CommandMenuBar controls retain their native HTML buttons,existing focus/keyboard/dispatch state machine and visual styling while exposing the required menuitem role. The shared Writer/Calc document title gains h1 semantics with identical text sizing and line height. Calc row/column/corner headers now contain their native selection buttons within proper header elements;corner accessible text and a valid status container complete the grid/chrome semantics. Tests migrate queries to the real menu items and native header buttons,not compatibility aliases or audit exclusions. Native command/cell/selection/input ownership is unchanged. Actual foundation/launcher axe checks and all three Writer dialog geometry viewports pass;full native UI/accessibility service parity remains unclaimed.
